topic: The Mechanics of Attention: How LLMs 'Understand' Context
target_audience: University students and aspiring AI developers

sections.title: The Intuition: Selective Focus
lecture_lines: Attention is like a flashlight in a dark room.
It lets models focus on what truly matters.
We prioritize relevant information over background noise.
animations: Show a noisy field of gray dots (#808080) and one bright green dot (#00FF00) moving. The green dot gets a circle around it.
A simple frog icon (#90EE90) appears on the left; a fly icon (#FF6347) appears on the right. A bright beam connects them.
A sequence of boxes (words) appears. Lines from all boxes converge on a central 'Meaning' node (#FFD700).

sections.title: Prerequisite: The Language of Vectors
lecture_lines: Computers process numbers, not raw text.
Embeddings map words into a multi-dimensional space.
Related concepts sit closer together in this space.
animations: A grid appears. Two points labeled 'King' (#4169E1) and 'Queen' (#FF69B4) appear close to each other.
Add a point 'Car' (#808080) far away from 'King' and 'Queen'. An arrow highlights the distance between 'King' and 'Car'.
The points 'King' and 'Queen' flash. A line connecting them shows their relationship vector.

sections.title: The Triple Identity: Query, Key, and Value
lecture_lines: Each word transforms into three specialized vectors.
Query asks: What information am I looking for?
Key says: Here is what I offer others.
Value holds the actual content being shared.
animations: A word box 'Bank' (#FFFFFF) splits into three colored boxes: Q (#FF0000), K (#0000FF), and V (#00FF00).
The Q box (#FF0000) glows. A magnifying glass icon appears next to it to represent a search.
The K box (#0000FF) glows. An ISBN barcode icon appears next to it representing an identifier.
The V box (#00FF00) glows. A book icon appears to represent the information carried.
The Q, K, and V boxes arrange in a row, clearly labeled in their colors.

sections.title: The Math of Matching: Scaled Dot-Product
lecture_lines: We multiply Query and Key to find relevance.
This dot-product measures how well they match.
Scaling ensures the mathematical gradients remain stable.
animations: A Q vector (#FF0000) on the left. A column of K vectors (#0000FF) on the right.
Lines connect Q to each K. Where they meet, a numerical score appears in a small box.
One connection line thickens and turns bright yellow (#FFFF00) as the high score flashes.
A formula 'Score / sqrt(dk)' appears. A large number (50) is divided to become a stable number (5).
The scores arrange into a heatmap grid with varying shades of orange (#FFA500).

sections.title: Softmax: Turning Scores into Percentages
lecture_lines: Softmax converts raw scores into clear probabilities.
These weights always sum to one hundred percent.
They determine how much each word contributes.
animations: A bar chart with three bars of different heights representing raw scores (10, 2, 1).
The bars transform into percentages (80%, 15%, 5%). A label 'Sum = 100%' (#00FF00) appears.
In the sentence 'River bank', the 'River' box gets a bright 80% spotlight while others dim.

sections.title: Multi-Head Attention: Parallel Perspectives
lecture_lines: One attention head cannot capture every relationship.
Multi-head attention runs several processes in parallel.
Different heads focus on grammar, logic, or context.
animations: A single 'Attention Head' box (#A9A9A9) labeled 'Head 1' appears.
The box splits into 4 colored boxes: Head 1 (#FF0000), Head 2 (#0000FF), Head 3 (#00FF00), Head 4 (#FFFF00).
Labels appear for each: 'Grammar', 'Logic', 'Time', 'Entities' next to respective heads.
Different colored lines connect the same words, showing unique perspectives from each head.
The 4 boxes merge back into one large, multi-colored 'Multi-Head Output' block.

sections.title: The Output: A Context-Rich Representation
lecture_lines: We multiply attention weights by the Value vectors.
This blends information from all relevant neighbors.
The result is a word enriched by its context.
animations: The 80% weight from 'River' is multiplied by its Value vector (#00FF00).
A chameleon icon (#FFFFFF) representing the word 'Bank' changes color to blue (#0000FF) near 'River'.
The blue 'Bank' vector moves to the final output layer, glowing with its new context-rich identity.
